description: Machine-readable privacy inventory for the Hemisphere Defense website. This file must describe reality: update it, the Privacy Policy (src/pages/innerPages/Privacy.tsx), and the point-of-collection notice whenever a data flow is added or removed. scripts/privacy-check.mjs enforces parts of it at build time.

consentBanner.reason: No cookies and no non-essential tracking exist, so there is nothing to consent to. If any entry is ever added to cookies/analytics/advertising, a consent layer must be implemented BEFORE that technology ships, not after.

dataCollection.purpose: Respond to and route visitor inquiries
dataCollection.storage: Delivered to the info@haiaero.com inbox; not stored by the website
dataCollection.retention: Business correspondence retention (business decision, see PRIVACY-NOTES.md)
dataCollection.legalBasisNote: Data is necessary to fulfill the visitor's own request; no marketing use

dataCollection.retention: Unknown from this repository; confirm with the hosting provider (see PRIVACY-NOTES.md)
dataCollection.legalBasisNote: Standard operation of the requested service

thirdParties.name: Web3Forms
thirdParties.dataReceived: Contact form field contents, on submit only

vocabularyIdentifiers.note: Namespace URIs that appear in source as identifiers only. They are never fetched at runtime, set no cookies, and send no data. Listed here so scripts/privacy-check.mjs can distinguish them from real external requests.

hosts.www.sitemaps.org: XML namespace for the generated sitemap (scripts/generate-seo-files.mjs).

searchMeasurement.note: Search performance is measured through Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools only. Both are verified by DNS TXT record, which adds no script, no cookie, no browser storage, and no third-party request to any page. No analytics, tag manager, or advertising pixel is present, and none may be added without updating this file, the Privacy Policy, and the point-of-collection notice, and implementing consent first.
searchMeasurement.verificationMethod: DNS TXT (preferred). An HTML verification file is the fallback; it is a static file and also adds no script.
